text: You set the ALCHEMITER to cast THREE (3) PERFECTLY GENERIC OBJECTS for some reason, expending a total of 6 units of BUILD GRIST.
These things look completely useless. What a waste!
Out of the corner of your eye, you notice there's something in the sky.
alt: You set a counter interface to three, which seems to cost six build grist. The pattern on the large ALCHEMITER glows, and three green cubes appear.
command: John: Switch modus and use telescope to inspect sky.
